description: On the tabletop in front of you there’s a dark cup, a toothbrush, and a small tube of toothpaste with its cap nearby. The right hand reaches into the cup and lifts out the right-hand object toothbrush, while the left hand slides in to pick up the left-hand object toothpaste tube; the left hand aims the nozzle over the toothbrush head and squeezes a small line of paste onto the bristles while the right hand holds the brush steady, then the left hand loosens its grip as the right hand starts moving the toothbrush back toward the cup.
